charts.title: WASP-19 b: orbits around Wattle
charts.description: The orbits of Wattle's planets in this map from above, to scale, with WASP-19 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Sodickson & Grunblatt 2025 (2025ApJ...993...78S), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname SODICKSON__AMP__GRUNBLATT_2025): P 0.78883900702 d

charts.title: WASP-19 b: transmission spectrum
charts.description: WASP-19 b's transmission spectrum: the fraction of starlight the planet blocks as it crosses its star, larger where its atmosphere absorbs. 9 measured bins from Bean et al. 2013 (Magellan II Landon Clay Telescope, MMIRS), as the NASA Exoplanet Archive lists them. Horizontal bars are wavelength bins; vertical bars are the published 1-sigma errors. The archive holds 1 other paper for this planet; this chart draws the one with the most bins.
notes: Magellan II Landon Clay Telescope, MMIRS
Values as the NASA Exoplanet Archive lists them.

charts.title: WASP-19 b: its transit
charts.description: WASP-19 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (89, 90, 99) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 35516889, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 6-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 6-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
